title: (Pwn2Own) NVIDIA Triton Inference Server IPC Push Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NVIDIA Triton Inference Server. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of IPC messages. A crafted IPC Push request can trigger a write past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of root.
